design: 2x2 evidence-presence diagnostic; four related decision sites, twelve fresh contexts; each context sees every condition once and one view of each site
target_family: Four exact predicates from BDDScenarioValuesSpec.findings and BDDScenarioFieldsSpec.findings, both linked to SG-SPEC-0070.

factors.contract: The approved source contract defines exact nonempty IDs, optional supplied titles, and nonempty ordered steps of nonempty strings.
factors.implementation_link: The target-containing contiguous class/method excerpt, Specification base, evaluator and composition registration are supplied.

controlled_inputs: same target expression and target-specific method body across the four evidence cells
same architecture profile, rubric bytes, questions, and annotation instructions
only adopted contract and explicit Specification linkage evidence vary within each target

assignment_balance.per_context: four distinct targets and exactly one case from each evidence cell
assignment_balance.presentation_order: each cell appears three times at each packet position
assignment_balance.same_target_views: no annotator receives multiple evidence cells for the same target

primary_observations: opportunity and concern-kind label distributions by target and evidence cell
decisive coverage per axis by target and cell
whether exact added fragments appear in rationales and evidence quotes

directional_hypotheses_not_gold_labels.contract: At fixed implementation-link presence, the adopted contract may reduce uncertainty about validity for the corresponding target. It does not predetermine policy versus mechanics.
directional_hypotheses_not_gold_labels.implementation_link: At fixed contract presence, explicit class, Specification and composition evidence may move opportunity toward excluded while leaving concern kind independently assessable.
directional_hypotheses_not_gold_labels.combined: The combined cell may clarify existing representation; concern kind can remain uncertain where domain purpose is not specified.

interpretation_limits: Four related decision sites from two classes under one Specification lineage are not an independent sample of the codebase.
Three fresh contexts per target-cell support descriptive comparison, not significance or classifier accuracy claims.
Each context sees four related cases; case-local instructions and balanced order reduce but cannot eliminate cross-case carryover.
The approved contract defines validity but does not itself settle the policy-versus-mechanics boundary.
Agent model identity is inherited and must be recorded as unverified unless exposed by the runtime.
Do not change v2 labels, failed H2, production prompts, S/U state, or metric storage from this diagnostic.
